boroughs = sorted(df['borough'].tolist())

n = len(boroughs)

# Compute z-scores using population variance denominator (as in Moran's I)
mean_val = np.mean(values)
m2 = np.mean((values - mean_val)**2)
std_val = np.sqrt(m2)
z = (values - mean_val) / std_val

# Compute row-standardized spatial lag (average of neighbor z's)
lag = np.zeros(n)

for i, b in enumerate(boroughs):
